name: LuBan Mysteries
overview: Master carpenter Li Mudun, famed for his skill with ancient Luban techniques, becomes the prime suspect in a series of eerie, superstition-filled murders. Determined to clear his name, Li teams up with detective Yang Zong and forensic doctor Su Qingyun. With reason and justice, the trio races to stop a new wave of killings and expose the truth behind the so-called “supernatural.”
